[ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Metropolitan Ministries provides back-to-school supplies for families in need
item.description: Metropolitan Ministries hosted its back-to-school bash. Families could shop for free backpacks, sneakers, school uniforms and other school items.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Zelenskyy says a North Korean missile fired by Russia killed a family in central Ukraine
item.description: A large family is dead in central Ukraine. The missile that killed them wasn't even Russian. It came from a supply chain that now runs through Moscow, Pyongyang, and Tehran.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] The Art of Banksy now on display at Straz Center in Tampa
item.description: The exhibit which runs at Straz Center until September 27, features more than 160 original works including prints, canvases, sculptures, limited edition pieces, and more.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Event travel drives record $36 million spring tax collection in Pinellas County
item.description: A surge in special event travel and group trips helped Pinellas County tourism leaders generate record tax revenues this spring, fueling local beach recovery efforts.
